init.description: Initialise a Cargo workspace inside an Nx workspace.

crate.description: Scaffold a new Cargo workspace-member crate (library by default, binary with --bin).

binary.description: Scaffold a new Cargo binary crate.

library.description: Scaffold a new Cargo library crate.

release-version.description: Bump a Cargo crate's version. Invoked by `nx release version`, not directly.

doctor.description: Diagnose nxrust workspace issues (read-only): cross-language `^build` test seams (ISS-001).

add-rust-reference.description: Wire a JS/TS project to a sibling Rust crate with the D-009 cross-language test-seam contract (overrides JS `test.dependsOn` so JS tests never trigger a transitive cargo build).
